title: interactive rag scenarios: tool timeouts and resilient fallbacks quickstart
author: Ava Chen
description: Adds an interactive quickstart demonstrating robust RAG agent patterns when calling external tools: per-tool timeout and retry policies, deterministic fallback strategies (local cache / degraded-mode answers), session replay for authoring and debugging, and lightweight telemetry probes for latency-sensitive deployments. The quickstart includes a compact dev server to run scenarios locally, stepwise assertions for authoring test cases, and CI smoke tests that validate timeouts and fallback behavior. Motivated by ENG-1843 and on-call feedback about tool stalls increasing MTTR; this quickstart is aimed at engineers evaluating production guardrails for tool-calling agents and improves observability during local dev and CI verification.

release_notes: Added 'Interactive RAG Scenarios with Tool Timeouts' quickstart: includes local devserver, session replay, per-tool timeout helpers, stepwise assertion harness, and CI smoke tests to validate fallback behavior; useful for teams building tool-calling agents and evaluating production guardrails.
testing_notes: To run locally: yarn install; yarn devserver:start; open http://localhost:3000/play and run provided scenarios. CI smoke job runs step_assertions.test.ts which verifies tool timeout, fallback marker presence, and replay determinism. Use REPLAY_DETERMINISTIC_CLOCK env in CI to avoid timing flakiness.
